english.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that someone reassures another person.
Use this when assuring someone means calming their worries and making them feel confident.

examples.english: Having you help really does reassure me.
examples.traditional: 有你幫手，真係令我放心。
examples.jyutping: jau5 nei5 bong1 sau2 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 fong3 sam1

examples.english: This clearly written contract will assure the client.
examples.traditional: 呢份合約寫得咁清楚，令客戶放心。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 se2 dak1 gam3 cing1 co2 ling6 haak3 wu6 fong3 sam1
